markdownMode.description: Markdown handling mode: passthrough / strip / native

enableUpdateCheck.description: Check npm registry for updates on startup

logBufferSize.description: Number of log lines retained for /logs command

inboundRateLimitMs.description: Per-user/group inbound rate limit in ms (0 = disabled)

silentKeywords.description: Messages containing any of these keywords are silently dropped

responseGuidelines.description: Response format constraints injected at the top of system prompt. Default = DEFAULT_RESPONSE_GUIDELINES (v1.9.1+). Empty string disables.

ignoreSenderBot.description: Ignore messages from other bot accounts (sender.bot=true) to prevent bot-to-bot loops. When true, bot messages are dropped and passiveMode.botSuppressionMs takes effect.

knownBotIds.description: Manual whitelist of known bot QQ numbers. Highest priority recognition, useful for bots that don't support auto-discovery via [BOT:xxx] signature.

botSignatureStyle.description: Bot identification strategy. 'visible' (default) appends [BOT:selfId] to message text - reliable, no startup spam. 'zero-width' uses invisible Unicode characters. 'none' disables text signatures entirely. Note: an earlier 'metadata' option (OneBot json-segment handshake) was removed in v1.9.2 because json segments render as visible card messages in QQ, causing startup broadcast spam.

debug.description: Enable verbose debug logging for message processing pipeline (self-filter, bot-filter, mention, reaction). Recommended only for troubleshooting.

passiveMode.description: Passive observation mode: AI watches all group messages and decides whether to chime in. AI replies [SILENT] to stay quiet.

botDialogMaxRounds.description: Hard cap on consecutive bot-to-bot exchanges before self-quiet (resets on user message). Default 5.

dialogTimeoutMs.description: Dialog state reset after this many ms of no new messages. Default 60s.

botStopKeywords.description: User stop-intent keywords. When any keyword is in the user message, bots enter 'dialog stopped' state and may reply with a brief acknowledgement.

botStopReplyEnabled.description: When user sends a stop-intent message, whether THIS bot may reply with a brief acknowledgement. Default true.

botStopReplyRatio.description: Fraction of bots that reply with a stop-acknowledgement (selfId hash distribution). Default 0.66 (~2/3).

botStopReplyDelayMaxMs.description: Max stagger delay (ms) for stop-acknowledgement replies. Default 300ms.

napcat.label: NapCat (OneBot 11)
napcat.description: Connect to QQ via NapCat/OneBot v11
